launchProof.askIntro: We send your period and key figures to the firm with the request, so you do not need to retype them.
launchProof.askSavedBody: Reference {id}. Email is not connected here, so nothing was emailed: the firm reads the request in Muhasib. To reach us directly, email {name} at {email}.
launchProof.askNote: Anything else the firm should know (optional)
launchProof.askNoEmail: Requests are stored in Muhasib and are not emailed automatically. You can also email {name} at {email}.
launchProof.askFailed: The request could not be saved. Try again, or email {email}.
launchProof.askYearEndHint: Not sure the year is ready to close? Send the period to the firm.
launchProof.readinessSubtitle: What to fix so your invoices pass the UAE e-invoicing (PINT AE) checks.
launchProof.readinessScopeNone: You chose not to be in e-invoicing scope.
launchProof.readinessNoDate: Choose your e-invoicing scope to see your go-live date.
launchProof.readinessCountdown: {days} days to go-live on {date}, per the Ministry of Finance timeline. Confirm for your entity.
launchProof.readinessInForce: Go-live date {date} has been reached, per the Ministry of Finance timeline. Confirm for your entity.
launchProof.readinessDateNote: Dates follow the published Ministry of Finance timeline and may change. Confirm them for your entity.
launchProof.readinessItem_scope: E-invoicing scope and turnover band chosen
launchProof.readinessDone_scope: Your scope sets the go-live date.
launchProof.readinessDone_supplier_ident: TRN, address, emirate and trade licence are complete.
launchProof.readinessDone_customer_detai: Every customer with a TRN has a full address.
launchProof.readinessDone_provider: A provider is connected and active.
launchProof.readinessHint_scope: Choose B2B, B2G or both, and your turnover band.
launchProof.readinessHint_supplier_ident: Add your TRN, street, city, emirate and trade licence number (ibr-128, 132, 143, 150).
launchProof.readinessHint_customer_detai: Customers with a TRN need street, city and emirate on the contact (ibr-144).
launchProof.readinessHint_product_codes: Give goods an item code (SKU or GTIN). Reverse-charge goods need a GTIN (ibr-174).
launchProof.readinessHint_provider: Sending is off until an accredited e-invoicing provider is connected.
launchProof.readinessTxOff: Transmission is off. Nothing is sent to your customers or the tax authority until an accredited e-invoicing provider is connected.
